name: R90 chronological early-era D1 four-K floor-risk research analogue
target: D2 open OR close at contemporaneous ordinary-share down-limit price
features_known_by: D1 09:34 after first four completed minute bars
model: SimpleImputer(median, add_indicator=True) -> StandardScaler -> LogisticRegression(C=0.1, max_iter=2000, random_state=20261013)
action_threshold: strictly above the training predicted-score 75th percentile
selection: no validation or test based feature/threshold changes
exit: same D2 morning greater than 7 percent next traded minute open else D2 close
pause_feedback: original pure-close shadow gate stays frozen
training_population: all original B2 shadow trades with D2 outcome before 2019-01-01, including months later paused by the pure-close shadow gate
evaluation_population: only original monthly-pause-allowed four-K trades; no replacement after risk reject
